tweets.text:
segment portfolio into long term plays & short term plays

for long term plays commit to buying over a range of prices & time intervals with intent of holding for minimum X amount of time with a max price invalidation to cut when you're wrong

protects downsides while protecting upside by forcing yourself to hold for extended period of time if stop loss is not hit

e.g. you believe pump bottom is close, you want to buy $100k worth, you buy $20k each week next 5 weeks and cut entire position if it trades beneath .0014 on a high timeframe close like the weekly, slam entire size into position if it closes above .0034, now your entry is averaged over finite amount of time and you're less worried about low tf price action because you're still building the position, but you also have levels where you want to be fully in or fully out

then you just move to cold storage wallet & revisit when your time interval or price target is hit, say 6 months or new all time highs at .009
